ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The attribution «Браминская мудрость Рамакришна» (Braminskaya mudrost' Ramakrishna, 'Brahmanic wisdom Ramakrishna') is printed without a period between its two parts; it is given as 'Brahmanic wisdom. Ramakrishna.' as elsewhere in this book. «Сила божья» (sila bozh'ya) is 'the power of God'; pronouns for God stay lowercase.

Source observation: [6] attribution «Браминская мудрость Рамакришна.» lacks the period after «мудрость» found elsewhere («Браминская мудрость. Рамакришна.»); translated as 'Brahmanic wisdom. Ramakrishna.'
